label: View
description: A saved list of items, held here and shared by every app: which items, and how each layout shows them. Written only through `/views`: created, changed at a version, and deleted, which removes it at once with no trash. Lifecycle bounded to active | revoked. Has no tier.

query.description: Which items the view lists. `types`: type identifiers, each with its subtypes; empty or absent lists every type the reading key reads. `tier`: `library`, `feed` or `all`; absent is `all`. `state`: `active`, `archived` or both; absent is both. `filter`: an expression in the listing grammar's `filter`. `beneath`: an item id; the item and everything under it by `parent-of`.

layouts.description: How the view shows its items, in order, at least one. Each layout has an `id` unique in the view, a `kind` (`list`, `table`, `board`, `gallery`, `calendar`, `timeline`, `chart` or `map`), and an optional `title`, `sort`, `group`, `shown` and the options its kind takes. A layout never narrows which items the view lists
